text:
ops-sre: folks — we just discovered an overnight coverage gap for the 02:00-06:00 UTC window tonight. anikais OOO and kevin is blocked in back-to-back partner calls. we have a small spike of 504s hitting the vectorizer tier; not a full outage yet but customers in EU/APAC are intermittently impacted. can someone pick up primary?

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-1837123456 - vectorizer-504-spike, severity:P2. Paging rules applied: primary->secondary->rotation. Incident channel: #inc-1837123456.

maria: I can take primary for 02:00-05:30 UTC if that helps. will be on a laptop and can bridge. :raised_hands:

kevin: I can be secondary to cover 05:30-07:00 UTC, but i've got the meeting until 02:30 UTC, so not available for the first 30m. if maria can start, that should work. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: thanks. maria — quick handoff checklist: 1) confirm you can reach prod dashboards, 2) check the runbook, 3) open a bridge if you need synchronous debugging. Also escalate to oncall-sre if it becomes P1.

maria: got it. linking the runbook and the two dashboards: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vectorizer-504 and https://dash.redwood.internal/d/vectorizer/latency-errors

maria: quick snippet i'll run on any node if we need to validate pods/cache:
```
# list vectorizer pods
kubectl get pods -l app=vectorizer -n inference
# tail logs for the last error spike
kubectl logs -l app=vectorizer -n inference --since=10m | grep -i "timeout\|504" -A3 -B2
```

ops-sre: note: there's an autoscaler tweak that was rolled last week (deploy-bot posted it). if you see an increase in queued requests, check the ASG/process restart count before scaling manually. deploy-bot: @deploy-bot can you paste the rollout id?

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-11-vectorizer-autoscale (merged 2026-11-10). If manual rollback needed: `revert r-2026-11-vectorizer-autoscale` via the console.

santiago: for customer impact assessment - current alert group shows ~12 distinct customers affected, mostly small-volume batch jobs. not yet impacting realtime SLAs for top-tier customers. recommend notifying support to watch tickets and prepare a customer advisory only if we see >5% error rate sustained for 15m.

maria: i'm starting the bridge now (zoom: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1837123456). i'm seeing 2/6 pods in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-23. investigating logs.

kevin: copying my quick checklist for when i take over: 1) verify bridge + slack presence, 2) check queued tokens in queue-service, 3) run `curl` against /health endpoints, 4) ensure fallback model route is active.

ops-sre: perfect. remember prefix cache might cause repeated 504s if a node repeatedly fails; if that's the case, trigger the node isolation play (runbook section 4).

maria: isolated one pod, restarted, error rate dropped to ~1.2% from 4.8%. looks like the autoscaler didn't spin up because of a taint on new nodes. working on untainting and verifying scaling.

kevin: if it spikes back after 05:30 UTC ping me on this thread and i'll take primary. i'll watch the metrics 05:15-07:00 UTC.

anika: thanks for covering y'all — my PTO is confirmed, enjoy the evening. please escalate if this looks like a platform-level regression.

ops-sre: summary for handoff: maria = primary 02:00-05:30 UTC (bridge up), kevin = secondary 05:30-07:00 UTC. runbook link and rollout id posted. customer impact limited right now (12 customers, mostly batch). escalate to P1 if >5% error rate for 15m or core-realtime customers hit SLA. closing the coverage gap. :white_check_mark:

maria: confirmed. i'll post a short handoff note at 05:25 with status and any persistent mitigations.

kevin: acknowledged. thanks.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add incident tags (service:vectorizer, region:eu, region:apac) and attach runbook to the incident.

maria: done — incident updated with tags and runbook. handing off to kevin at 05:25 UTC unless anything changes.

kevin: i'll post a brief wrap and recommended follow-ups (autoscaler fix + node taint audit) after I triage in the morning.

ops-sre: thanks team. pairing notes: if anyone needs immediate help while on bridge, ping @oncall-sre and include `INC-1837123456` in the subject.

maria: handing over now to kevin. glhf. :v
name: 1837123456-urgent-overnight-bridge-eu-to-apac-handoff.json
